text: アロマなおねえさんの　＊が　しょうぶを　しかけてきた！

structure.jp: アロマなおねえさんの　＊が

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: てくる after a verb says the action comes toward you. しかけてきた = 'came at you and started (a battle)'.

patterns.name: 〜の (same person)
patterns.span: アロマなおねえさんの　＊
patterns.explanation: の between a label and a name says both are the same person: the label tells what kind of person the name is. アロマなおねえさんの　＊ = '＊ the Aroma Lady'.

patterns.name: 〜な
patterns.explanation: な joins a describing word to the person or thing it describes. Here it playfully treats アロマ as a describing word. アロマなおねえさん = 'aroma-ish young lady'.
